$comment: Curated list of inline examples that are SUPPOSED to fail, so the
run-button suite does not report them. Anything not listed here that
produces an error is treated as a real failure.
alwaysAllowed: regexes matched against the rendered output. Use only for
outcomes that are correct by design everywhere — not to paper over bugs.
pages: page path -> { "<1-based Run button index>": "why it errors" }.
The index counts only buttons that are enabled (CLI-only buttons are
disabled and never clicked), matching what the suite reports on failure.
codeMarkers: if a block's own source contains one of these, its error is
treated as intentional. Prefer this — it keeps the reason next to the
example instead of in a separate file that drifts.
